tasks.prompt: Print the http.cat image URL for status code 404. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Quick start shows `cat-status 404` and the exact stdout URL.

tasks.prompt: Look up status code 418 and print the result as JSON. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Quick start shows `cat-status 418 --json`; Command reference documents `--json`.

tasks.prompt: List all client error (4xx) codes that cat-status supports, as JSON. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Quick start shows `--list 4xx`; Command reference synopsis allows `--list … [--json]`.

tasks.prompt: Save the http.cat image for status 200 to the file cats/ok.jpg, replacing the file if it already exists. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Quick start shows save for 200 and `--force` to overwrite; Command reference documents `--save` and `--force`.

tasks.prompt: Save the image for status 503 to a.jpg, but give up after 2 seconds if the download is too slow. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Command reference documents `--save <path>` and `--timeout <ms>` (milliseconds); 2 seconds = 2000.

tasks.prompt: Look up the status code -1 with cat-status. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Troubleshooting documents `cat-status -- -1` and exit code 2 (not 1).

tasks.prompt: What exit code does cat-status return for the real HTTP status 505? Reply with JSON only; the answer must be a JSON number, for example {"answer": 2}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Quick start and Troubleshooting both state exit code 2 for 505 (no cat image).

tasks.prompt: What exit code does cat-status return if I pass --timeout 3000 without --save? Reply with JSON only; the answer must be a JSON number, for example {"answer": 2}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Command reference says --timeout is only valid with --save; exit code table lists 1 as usage error.

tasks.prompt: Which product documents the non-standard status code 444? Reply with JSON only, for example {"answer": "..."}, lowercase product name.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Command reference non-standard table lists 444 → nginx.

tasks.prompt: Save the image for 418 to teapot.jpg, and never overwrite an existing file. Reply with JSON only, for example {"command":"cat-status ..."}.
tasks.fairness: Fair: Quick start and Command reference document --save without --force (refuses overwrite).
